visual.issue: The head start week crop shows only 6 of the 7 day boxes (Thursday Oct 29 is cut off) and the alt text says 'six day boxes', so the photo suggests the week page is missing a day.
The photo's first bullet is 'Month tabs down the right edge', but both crops cut off the right edge, so no month tabs are in frame (r005).

On head start pages the tab column reads JAN-OCT (2027), then NOV 2026, DEC 2026. The tabs are out of date order, and the Nov and Dec 2027 tabs disappear, so the same tab slot goes to a different year depending on the page.
The Start here crop shows only steps 1 and 2, while the bullet promises 4 steps; the lower-left of the photo is empty.
The day crop stops at 6pm and the alt text says 'time blocks from 6am to 6pm', which hides that blocks run to 10pm.
Step cards are part-empty: the step 2 card is about half blank below the Go there button, and steps 3 and 4 leave the bottom third empty (r006).
The 'top bar, on every page' map lists Year, Projects and Notes but leaves out Home, which is on the bar (Setup check's map includes it).
Notes and dot grid pages have only a forward arrow and no back arrow; the last notes and grid pages have no arrow at all.
The eyebrow 'SETUP CHECK' repeats the title 'Setup check' word for word; other pages use a category eyebrow.
Rows inside each band of the year grid are spaced differently per month (February and June rows sit lower than January/May and do not line up), so the grid looks uneven.
The This week's top 3 box leaves its bottom third empty, next to a full Notes box.
The habit circles almost touch across all 31 days, which leaves little room to fill a dot with the pen.
The Jan 1-3 day trail reads 'Dec 28 to Jan 3' where every other day reads 'Week N'; it is correct (head start week 10), but a buyer may not see why.
